heading: Weather in motion.
subtitle: Follow observed precipitation. Understand what may arrive next.
noPlaces: No matches from the provider. Add street, neighborhood and city; also try without the street number.
replayNote: 2–60 minutes · UTC · predictions use past observations only
clickMap: Click or drag target to move
chooseReplay: Choose a period or load the real example.
qualityNote: Coverage describes valid product pixels; it does not certify surface rainfall or beam visibility.
latestOnlyNote: Live forecasts belong to the latest observation. Advance to the last frame to see them.
noThreatsNote: An empty forecast does not establish dry conditions. Check coverage and observation age.
scienceNote: Experimental extrapolation, with uncertainty from motion and evolution. Confidence is a qualitative indicator, not a calibrated probability.
historyLiveOnly: Live alert history is separate from historical replay.
noHistory: No recorded alert changes for this location.
methodNote: Radar regions are tracked across observations. Motion and footprint geometry inform arrival estimates; unavailable or stale observations stop prediction.
refreshNote: Automatic check 60 s after the previous one completes; new observations depend on the radar.
metricsNote: Metrics are experimental and describe this episode only. Unmeasurable values remain unknown. Runs can differ in location, duration, and thresholds.
notOfficial: Not an official warning system. Follow local authorities.

errors.search_rate_limit: Please wait a moment before searching again.
errors.sample_unavailable: The real observation example is not available on this server.

errors.provider_unavailable: The NOAA data provider is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.replay_period: Select a past period spanning 2 to 60 minutes in UTC.
errors.gps: Location could not be obtained. Check your browser permission or enter coordinates.
errors.sound: Sound could not be enabled in this browser.
errors.search_consent_required: Enable external search below to find addresses. You can also enter coordinates or move the marker.

searchConsent: Enable external search: sends text and approximate map center to Photon. Preference saved only in this browser.
searchProviderNote: Photon search is active. It receives your search text and approximate map center.
searchConsentRequired: Enable external search below to find addresses. You can also enter coordinates or move the marker.
localWatchNote: Your last location, radius and threshold stay only in this browser.
temporaryWatchNote: Temporary historical location. Returning to live restores your last saved location.
reflectivityNote: Radar echoes ≥5 dBZ do not confirm surface rainfall. Display covers only the target vicinity (radius + 20 km). Alerts use estimated precipitation rate.
rateNote: MRMS estimated precipitation rate, only around the target (radius + 20 km). An empty product does not rule out echoes in reflectivity.
noLayer: The selected layer is unavailable for this observation.
noLayerCoverage: No valid coverage in the radar crop.
noEchoes: No echoes ≥5 dBZ in the observed crop. Check coverage and time.
noRate: No detectable estimated precipitation in the crop. Check reflectivity as well.
compositeReflectivityNote: Composite reflectivity: maximum in the atmospheric column. Echoes ≥5 dBZ do not confirm surface rainfall. Only the target vicinity is shown (radius + 20 km). Alerts use estimated precipitation rate.

push.title: Rain notifications outside this page
push.description: Receive observed rain onset and qualifying arrival alerts, even with this tab closed. This computer and the Tláloc server must stay on. Your browser and operating system must allow background notifications. Pausing the map does not stop these notifications.
push.privacy: The subscription is stored on this computer. Encrypted messages pass through the browser push service without exact addresses or coordinates. Disabling notifications preserves saved monitored locations.
push.inactive: The server has stopped this subscription. Enable again to restore it.
push.unsupported: Background push is unavailable in this browser. Open this same URL in full Edge or Chrome; an embedded browser may not support push. HTTPS or localhost is required.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser's site permissions, then enable again.
push.dismissed: Permission was not granted. Use Enable when you want to allow notifications.
push.unavailable: The notification service is unavailable. Check that the local server is running.
push.storage: This browser could not save the subscription. Enable local storage and try again.
push.subscriptionError: Could not create the push subscription. If using the embedded browser, open this same URL in full Edge or Chrome. Check connectivity and site permissions, then retry.
push.statusError: Cannot confirm the saved subscription. Check the local server; the watch may still be enabled. Disable requires a server connection.
push.updateError: The new watch settings could not be saved. Background notifications still use the previously saved watch. Check the local server.
push.disableError: Could not stop the background watch. Keep the local server running and retry Disable.
push.testError: The test could not be sent. Check the subscription, browser and local server.
push.deliveryError: The latest background check or delivery failed. Notifications may be unavailable until the next successful check.
push.replay: Historical replay does not change the saved background watch or produce notifications.
push.testSent: Test accepted by the push service. Check your system notifications; delivery also depends on browser and OS settings.

monitor.title: Monitored locations
monitor.description: Save a location to check it every 2 minutes with the page closed and notifications off. This computer and the server must stay on. Notifications are configured separately.
monitor.name: Location name
monitor.checkError: Check failed or observations unavailable or stale
monitor.loadError: Could not load saved locations. Check the server connection.
monitor.originError: The server rejected this page origin. Open the app from the same server address on localhost or your local network.
monitor.limitError: Eight locations are already saved. Remove one before adding another.
monitor.locationError: The location or name is invalid. Check coordinates and settings.
monitor.saveError: The server could not save the change. Retry; if it persists, check server storage permissions.
monitor.connectionError: Could not connect to the server to save the change. Try again.
